stories_selected.title: Security Update for SQL Server 2025 RTM (GDR)
stories_selected.dba_relevance: A GDR security update for SQL Server 2025 RTM addresses CVE-2026-66813, a Denial of Service vulnerability; DBAs should download KB5132748 from the Microsoft Download Center or Update Catalog and apply it promptly.

stories_selected.title: Security Update for SQL Server 2019 RTM (GDR)
stories_selected.dba_relevance: SQL Server 2019 receives the same CVE-2026-66813 Denial of Service fix via GDR KB5132751; DBAs running SQL Server 2019 RTM should apply this update regardless of whether they are on a cumulative update track.

stories_selected.title: Amazon Aurora and RDS now support Graviton5-based R9g database instances
stories_selected.dba_relevance: Amazon Aurora (PostgreSQL and MySQL) now supports the new Graviton5-based R9g instance family; DBAs planning capacity upgrades or instance-type migrations should evaluate R9g as a potential performance and cost option.

stories_selected.title: Aurora PostgreSQL with express configuration now supported in CloudFormation
stories_selected.dba_relevance: Aurora PostgreSQL clusters using the express configuration can now be provisioned and managed via AWS CloudFormation, enabling DBAs and DBREs to incorporate express-tier Aurora PostgreSQL into infrastructure-as-code pipelines.
